heading: Our migration process
intro: We turn your cloud migration strategy into reviewable stages, with acceptance checks before workloads move into production.

items.title: Assess
items.description: We inventory workloads, data, dependencies, security requirements, and operating constraints.

items.title: Plan
items.description: We define the target architecture, migration sequence, acceptance checks, and rollback approach.

items.title: Pilot
items.description: We test the approach on a representative workload and use the findings to refine the plan.

items.title: Migrate
items.description: We move applications and data in agreed groups while tracking issues and cutover decisions.

items.title: Validate
items.description: We check data integrity, application behavior, access, performance, backups, and recovery readiness.

items.title: Optimise
items.description: We review resource usage, monitoring, cost, and operating documentation after the move.

heading: Our DevOps and reliability process
intro: We start with the current delivery path, then improve the steps that create repeated work or operational risk.

items.title: Audit
items.description: We review deployments, environments, access, monitoring, and the incidents your team is trying to prevent.

items.title: Automate
items.description: We introduce scoped delivery and infrastructure automation with checks, review points, and documented ownership.

items.title: Monitor
items.description: We connect agreed service health signals to dashboards, alerts, and response procedures.

items.title: Improve
items.description: We use release and incident findings to prioritize the next improvement with your team.

heading: Our cloud cost optimization process
intro: We separate low-risk changes from decisions that need workload testing, financial review, or a longer operating view.

items.title: Audit
items.description: We review billing, resource inventory, usage patterns, ownership, and current commitments.

items.title: Quick wins
items.description: We prioritize changes with clear ownership and limited operational risk, then validate their effect.

items.title: Long-term savings
items.description: We assess resource design, scaling, retention, and commitment options against expected demand.

items.title: Ongoing monitoring
items.description: We establish reporting and review points so owners can investigate new cost changes.
